_comment: Section 10. `work_speed` multiplies craft time. Behavioural flags are read by the systems named in their comments.

traits.name: Careful
traits.blurb: Slower, but nothing goes wrong on their watch.

traits.name: Curious
traits.blurb: Reads everything. Drifts toward whatever is interesting.

traits.name: Hoarder
traits.blurb: Will not let go of a stack they are standing on.

traits.name: Steady
traits.blurb: Has seen worse. Others are calmer nearby.

traits.name: Haunted
traits.blurb: Something followed them aboard. Reads the dead crew's logs like letters.
